description: TwingateGateway represents a Gateway in Twingate.

spec.description: TwingateGatewaySpec defines the desired state of TwingateGateway

address.description: Address Connectors dial to reach the Gateway, for when they reach it indirectly, e.g. through a proxy, ingress, or private endpoint. Mutually exclusive with serviceRef.

host.description: DNS name or IPv4 address of the Gateway.

port.description: Port the Gateway is reachable on.

remoteNetworkId.description: ID of the Twingate Remote Network this Gateway belongs to. Overrides the operator-wide default (TWINGATE_REMOTE_NETWORK_ID). Immutable once set.

serviceRef.description: Reference to the Service fronting the Gateway. The operator resolves the host from the Service and combines it with port into status.address. Mutually exclusive with address.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Service object. Defaults to the TwingateGateway's own namespace when omitted.

port.description: Port the Gateway is reachable on.

x509CertificateAuthorityRef.description: Reference to the TwingateCertificateAuthority whose X509 CA signs this Gateway's TLS certificates.

namespace.description: Namespace of the TwingateCertificateAuthority object. Defaults to the TwingateGateway's own namespace when omitted.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of serviceRef or address must be set
